'''Klev Natasken''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]] captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on [[Koovis]]. Two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrators]] were committed to rescue him before Natasken was transferred to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] for interrogation.
